When I took it back to them (via a tow) I was told once the fixed the hose that my transmission was basically screwed that is won't last long. I asked if they were gonna do anything about since it was there fault. I was told no I'd have to pay for it again. Absolutely pathetic.

Edit- was recently told by a friend that they had their vehicle taken here and long story short the whole thing happened again except for they didn't tighten the transmission oil pan down all the way and my friend driving home from picking up his vehicle ended up getting stranded on the road with a blown up transmission because all of the fluid leaked out. Unfortunately I hate to say this but this shop needs to be shut down and inspected thoroughly. I genuinely feel like they're not following proper procedures when they go to repair customer vehicles and at the end of the day they don't take responsibility for anything that they screw up so I highly recommend staying away from this shop. I have several several years of experience in the automotive industry but these guys are absolutely pathetic and should not be working in this field. Sorry if this seems derogatory or degrading, but if your work shows that you don't care then unfortunately this is the kind of response that you'll get. These individuals are not worth going to. I highly recommend looking for a different shop. DO NOT TAKE YOUR VEHICLE HERE.
